name: GizmoVR Video Player
summary: Lightweight free 180/360 VR cinema & mobile browser player smoothing local and web stereoscopic playback across Quest, iOS, and Android.
ranking_rationale: Built-in VR browser simplifies streaming straight from VR tubes on mobile headsets (trade-off: desktop PCVR decoding and NAS library UI trail Skybox/HereSphere).

pricing.free_tier: Free core player on Quest & Mobile
pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Built-in VR browser simplifies streaming straight from VR tubes on mobile headsets
Supports crisp 180 SBS/TB formats with adjustable IPD & screen tilt
cons: Desktop PCVR decoding and NAS library UI trail Skybox/HereSphere
Mobile gyroscope mode drains battery fast
